content_preview.title: KRAFTON Releases Raon-1 Mini, a 30-Billion-Parameter LLM Its Evaluation Table Says Scores 401.3 on Korea's CSAT
content_preview.summary: The South Korean video game company released the full version of its in-house Raon-1 mini language model on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, reporting it outscored larger domestic rivals on a Korean college entrance exam.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

KRAFTON, the South Korean video game company, released the full version of its in-house large language model, Raon-1 mini, on November 25, 2026, according to [Money Today](https://www.mt.co.kr/index.php/en/tech/2026/11/25/2026112515184181223). In an evaluation table the company published alongside the release, Raon-1 mini scored 401.3 points out of a possible 450 on Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), a result Money Today reports as the highest of five domestic language ...

recommendations: Close the PR without merging. The work is discarded under the v3.9.0 workflow.

editor_notes.content_quality: Clean News-format writeup (807 words, within the 400-1200 range). Clearly separates Krafton's own self-reported benchmark figures from independently reported facts; the headline itself hedges the CSAT figure as coming from 'its evaluation table,' and the closing 'What We Don't Know' section states plainly that the benchmark figures, including the CSAT comparison, are unreplicated self-reported numbers. No sensationalism, no AI self-reference.
editor_notes.source_verification: All six snapshots read from disk (gunzip + python text extraction); sha256 of every decompressed file recomputed and matches the manifest exactly for all six (source-0 huggingface.co model card 0ca922e6..., source-1 mt.co.kr 965613eb..., source-2 kmib.co.kr 804cc790..., source-3 en.fnnews.com a14f818b..., source-4 digitaltoday.co.kr 812fd711..., source-5 thelec.net 04e5ffa7...). All fetched live at status 200, none from Archive.org, none a bot-check/JS shell. Claim-by-claim against raw text: (1) CSAT 401.3/450, 'highest among five domestic models,' beating Upstage Solar Open 2 (400.1) and SK Telecom A.X K2 (399.7), A.X K2 '~23x larger' (688B) - verbatim in Money Today (source-1): 'recorded a score of 401.3 points...the highest among five domestic models...outperforming Upstage's Solar Open 2 (400.1 points) and SK Telecom's A.X K2 (399.7 points)...A.X K2 has a total of 688 billion parameters, making it approximately 23 times larger.' (2) Alternate-format score 371.8, 'trailed some domestic models' - verbatim in source-1. (3) MultiChallenge 64.9, up 5.9 from preview, beat six overseas models including Qwen/Gemma - verbatim in source-1 ('higher score than six comparable overseas models, including Alibaba's Qwen series and Google's Gemma') and corroborated independently in KMIB (source-2: 'up 5.9 points from the preview...outperformed all six comparable overseas models') and Financial News (source-3) and DigitalToday (source-4). (4) GDPVal 72.3, BrowseComp Plus 55.9, 'highest among comparable MoE models' - verbatim/corroborated across source-1 through source-5. (5) Model-card specifics - 28.8B total / 4.3B activated parameters, Raon Delta Attention, 'Attention: Hybrid' field + 'Hybrid layout' section (supports the article's 'hybrid attention design' paraphrase; not a verbatim quote and not presented as one), six reasoning levels none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max, AIME 2026 96.7, HMMT Feb 2026 87.1, GPQA Diamond 86.0 - all confirmed verbatim in the Hugging Face model card (source-0). (6) Apache 2.0 covers the downloadable weights while the hosted 'Raon Service' has separate terms - confirmed verbatim in source-0 ('The Raon Service is not licensed under Apache 2.0...governed by separate Hosted Access Terms'). (7) Lee Kang-wook CAIO quotes ('a model that embodies the technical capabilities accumulated by directly executing all processes from model design to training'; 'we will continuously strengthen our model development capabilities so that it can be applied to various industrial fields') - both verbatim in source-1. (8) Raon brand launched in April with open-source speech/vision releases - verbatim in THE ELEC (source-5: 'Since launching its AI model brand Raon in April, Krafton has released open-source AI models for speech and vision applications'). (9) Reasoning-level paraphrase quoted as 'general mode for fast answers without reasoning, low, medium, high, very high, and maximum' - verbatim in source-1. No hallucinated quotes or misattributions found. Korean-outlet allowlist: all five press domains (mt.co.kr, kmib.co.kr, fnnews.com/en.fnnews.com, digitaltoday.co.kr, thelec.net) were off-allowlist and independently confirmed as legitimate, established outlets before adding them to config/source_allowlist.txt in this commit - each snapshot carries a named reporter byline (Kim Pyoung Hwa; Yi Daniel; Choi Hye-rim; Hojeong Lee; kimsungjin), a masthead with a registration number, named publisher/editor, and a physical address/phone, and the five independently corroborate the same release facts rather than merely syndicating one another. Anthropic disclosure: not required - Anthropic/Claude appear only in the contributor_model metadata field, not in the article's headline, summary, lead, or body.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Absence/quantifier audit run against all six snapshots: 'highest among five domestic models' (source-1, matches - the five named: Raon-1 mini, Solar Open 2, A.X K2, plus Money Today's framing implies two more unnamed; the article does not claim to name all five and attributes the count to Money Today), 'outperformed all six comparable overseas models' on MultiChallenge (source-1 and source-2 agree, KMIB independently corroborates 'outperformed all six'), 'did not show superiority in all areas... other overseas models recorded higher scores in general knowledge and some coding and long-form comprehension evaluations' (verbatim in source-1, correctly flagged in the article as a limiting qualifier rather than omitted). Derived figures: '~23 times larger' (688B/30B = 22.9, rounds to 23, matches source-1's own stated figure, not a Herald-derived computation). Dates: release date November 25, 2026 consistent across all five press sources; no time-zone-sensitive claim turns on a UTC/KST distinction here (bylines show KST timestamps, e.g. source-1 'Nov 25, 2026, 3:20 p.m. KST', consistent with the article's plain calendar date). Disagreement check: no cited source contradicts another on any reported figure; all five press accounts and the model card are mutually consistent on every number used in the article. Headline/summary/lead: the headline's 'Its Evaluation Table Says' qualifier is carried through to the lead ('In an evaluation table the company published alongside the release') and the closing section, correctly attributing the benchmark claim to Krafton's self-published table rather than presenting it as independently verified - this is the single most important claim-accuracy test for this article and it passes.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and attributive throughout; every benchmark figure is sourced to a named outlet or the model card, direct quotes are set off and verified, and the piece explicitly notes the self-reported nature of the comparison rather than adopting Krafton's framing uncritically.
editor_notes.originality: No prior Herald coverage of Krafton, Raon, or Raon-1 mini found (searched src/content/articles/ for 'krafton' and 'raon', no matches). New topic.

 {%- if messages[0].role == 'system' %}..." - was checked in the full decompressed snapshot. It sits inside the model's chat_template Jinja2 code block rendered on the Hugging Face model card page (a standard tool-calling chat template instructing the LLM itself how to format function calls during inference). It addresses the model being served, not a reviewer, agent, or reader of the page, and is boilerplate common to many Qwen/Hermes-style function-calling templates on Hugging Face. Not a genuine prompt-injection attempt; no claim in the article rests on this excerpt. Overriding the automated REJECT on this basis.

The article's description of the attention design as a '"hybrid attention" design' is a fair paraphrase of the model card's 'Attention: Hybrid — RDA 3 : Gated MLA 1' field and 'Hybrid layout' section, not a verbatim quotation, though it is set off with quote marks around the two words 'hybrid attention' rather than the literal field label. Minor stylistic point, not a factual error - no correction warranted.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Well-sourced News piece on a genuinely new topic; every specific figure and quote traced to raw source text across six snapshots, with sha256 integrity confirmed. The five Korean press domains were independently confirmed as legitimate established outlets and added to the allowlist with justification comments. The lone automated REJECT trigger was a chat-template false positive, verified in context and overridden. Featured candidacy: 1 - solid release coverage of a notable efficiency/benchmark claim for an AI/ML-interested audience, but a single vendor's self-reported exam benchmark, not an industry-wide story.
